items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Milton Mezzrow had left me a whole cigar box full of tea... I said my mother's there in the house... I told Louis about this whole cigar box full of tea... take it. And pay Milt for it when you see him

ctx.x: We were talking about smoking pot informally before we, well we're still informal for that matter, but I mean before we turned the tape on we were talking about it. And you said, oh, boy I've got a funny story about Louis.

Oh yes. Well anyone who has read about Milton Mezzrow, he was a guy hanging around. He didn't play too well. He played the clarinet and saxophone but he always, he used to go out to Arizona and pick up some mighty fine tea, we used to call it. Tea. And it was a cigarette what we would be called a muggles. It was a muggle.
